question.text: REITs (Real Estate Investment Trusts) are typically classified as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 1.2.4, REITs are in the dual category — liquid (listed) but backed by illiquid real estate. The Trap: Pure classifications don't fit REITs. Cross-Exam Context: Useful classification when positioning REITs vs pure real-estate AIFs. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Offer REITs as a liquidity-friendly alternative within the real estate theme.
